m1-decompose.title: VarianceShares + decompose_segment_time_variance via TwoWayPool, synthetic-recovery TDD
m1-decompose.imperative: Create src/physics/instrument_panel/__init__.py (package marker + short docstring) and src/physics/instrument_panel/variance_decomposition.py with a frozen VarianceShares dataclass (car_reference_share, driver_utilization_share, residual_share, driver_utilization_is_floor: bool, plus provenance fields as needed) and decompose_segment_time_variance(values, drivers, classes) -> VarianceShares, realized via fit_two_way(values, teams=drivers, circuits=classes) from src.physics.layer2.pooling (car_reference_share=frac_circuit, driver_utilization_share=frac_team, residual_share=frac_resid; driver_utilization_is_floor=True always -- protected intent). NO bespoke model, NO interaction term. Create tests/unit/physics/instrument_panel/__init__.py and tests/unit/physics/instrument_panel/test_variance_decomposition.py: synthetic value = a*car_effect[class] + b*driver_effect[driver] + noise (reuse draw_ground_truth's generative style from scripts/pooling_imbalance_validation_665.py), asserting (1) shares sum to ~1.0 and each lies in [0,1], (2) raising b (driver coefficient) at fixed a raises driver_utilization_share monotonically across >=3 settings, (3) a pure-car signal (b~0) gives driver_utilization_share ~0 (small), (4) a pure-driver signal (a~0) gives car_reference_share ~0 (small), (5) driver_utilization_is_floor is True in every case, (6) a degenerate single-class or single-driver input returns a sane, non-crashing result with valid shares. RED: write the test file first (module does not yet exist), run pytest, observe collection failure -- manual attest. GREEN: implement until the exact required pytest command passes.
